source.description:
## PROBLEM

Dependency bumps are too noisy and too expensive to handle ad hoc. Across the xtrm ecosystem, every Dependabot/Renovate PR or lockfile/security workflow touch risks a disproportionate amount of operator time on scanners that block merges on ambiguous or low-risk cases, stale transitive lockfile entries, CI payload gates that fail for harness reasons, and toolchain micro-debugging instead of real risk reasoning. There is no repeatable capability that turns a dependency bump into an evidence-backed decision an agent can make consistently.

This epic builds that capability in its natural home — xtrm-tools — so it ships to every repo via `xt update`. Design decisions are locked in `~/dev/xtrm/docs/devops/dependency-bump-policy.md` (bead `unitAI-3v5sn`, specialists DB); the exhaustive spec is `~/dev/xtrm/docs/devops/dependencies-updating.md`.

## SUCCESS

A v0 `updating-dependencies` skill package is shipped in `.xtrm/skills/default/`, a deterministic inspector emits a stable `dependency_update_case.json`, and a minimal-permission GitHub Action wraps them to comment a verdict + label on dependency PRs. An agent (or human) invoking the skill on a real bump produces a consistent upgrade dossier and a verdict from the taxonomy, without inventing the process. The specialists repo adopts the output via its own CI-adoption epic (cross-linked).

## SCOPE

xtrm-tools repository, under `.xtrm/skills/default/updating-dependencies/` (skill, templates, schemas), and a new inspector + Action surface (location TBD by C1/D1 — likely `cli/` or a dedicated `packages/dep-inspect/`). May touch `xt update` asset contracts if new shippable files are added. Does NOT touch specialists workflow YAMLs (that is the specialists adoption epic) and does NOT modify deployer/SRE specialists (delivery boundary per spec §3).

## NON_GOALS

- Not a DevOps monolith: no auto-deploy, auto-rollback, or incident handling (spec §2).
- Not replacing SCA/SBOM/Dependabot/OSV/Snyk — consuming them (spec §2).
- No `xt dep` CLI command in this epic (deferred to v3+ after real cases prove the primitives, spec §17).
- No deployer/SRE specialist modifications; integration is via substrate issue + evidence refs (spec §3, §13).
- No lowering of security gates blindly — advisory/blocking split is evidence-based (policy doc §4).

## CONSTRAINTS

- Deterministic-first: anything computable (direct/transitive, prod/dev, release age, advisory match, usage) MUST come from parsers/scanners/registry metadata, not LLM invention (spec §6).
- Delivery boundary: capability prepares case + may propose patch/comment; deployer decides delivery; SRE observes post-deploy (spec §3).
- Skill must be rigid: specify inputs, source matrix tiers, verdict taxonomy with decision rules, cooldown policy, GitHub-Actions special case, required outputs — no free-form agent process invention (spec §8).
- v0 cooldown default = 7 days; bypass only via SECURITY_FORCED (policy doc §4.1).
- GitHub Action wrapper v1 permissions: read-only + PR comment only; no aggressive auto-mutation (spec §16).
- Telemetry/logging: inspector emits structured JSON (`dependency_update_case.json`, schema `xtrm.dependency_update_case.v0`); Action run produces a stable PR comment artifact and a machine-readable verdict label. No secrets/tokens in any emitted artifact.
- One branch per issue; PR workflow; no direct commits to default branch.

## VALIDATION

- [ ] v0 skill package present: SKILL.md + templates/{upgrade-dossier,pr-comment,research-matrix,post-deploy-watch-spec}.md + schemas/{dependency_update_case,upgrade_dossier}.schema.json
- [ ] Skill invokes cleanly on a sample bump and produces a dossier with all stable sections + a verdict from the taxonomy
- [ ] Inspector produces valid `dependency_update_case.json` (passes its JSON schema) from a sample PR diff/lockfile
- [ ] Action wrapper posts a PR comment with verdict + label on a test dependency PR; no write beyond comment
- [ ] Asset contract / `xt update` picks up the new skill so it installs into a target repo
- [ ] Smoke: end-to-end on one real Dependabot PR in a scratch repo (case → skill dossier → PR comment)
- [ ] No secrets/tokens present in any emitted artifact (grep check)

## OUTPUT

Shipped skill package + inspector + Action in xtrm-tools; version-tagged release that `xt update` can promote. Each child bead hands back changed-file lists, schema validation evidence, and the scratch-repo smoke result. Residual risks (ecosystem cooldown tuning, tarball diff depth) documented as follow-ups.

## REFERENCES

- `~/dev/xtrm/docs/devops/dependency-bump-policy.md` — decision layer (locked D1–D4, advisory/blocking policy, phased board)
- `~/dev/xtrm/docs/devops/dependencies-updating.md` — exhaustive spec (§1–21)
- specialists bead `unitAI-3v5sn` (design bead, specialists DB) — discovered this capability
- specialists CI-adoption epic (to be created, specialists DB) — consumes inspector/Action for osv/payload rework
- PR #152 (specialists) — concrete failure-mode evidence
